title: Admin Course CRUD — decomposed into 4 sub-cards
content:
⚠️ DECOMPOSED — this card has been split into 4 sub-cards. Do not implement from this card.

Sub-cards:
- AD-005-I18N: Add course form dict keys (low risk, no deps, can start first)
- AD-005-API: Backend CRUD API (high risk, depends on CM-001)
- AD-005-FORM: CourseForm component (medium risk, depends on AD-005-API)
- AD-005-PAGES: New/Edit pages + list enhancements (medium risk, depends on AD-005-FORM + AD-005-I18N)

Original scope:
- New Course form (full create form)
- Edit Course (from list click into edit)
- Delete Course (confirmation dialog)
- Toggle registration status inline
- i18n support
- Zod form validation

evidence.residual: Existing CM-001 API routes need verification that POST/PATCH/DELETE work for full course model with all fields.

comments.name: Agent
comments.text: Decomposed into 4 sub-cards (AD-005-API, AD-005-FORM, AD-005-PAGES, AD-005-I18N) after codebase exploration revealed POST/PATCH/DELETE API routes do NOT exist — card incorrectly claimed they did. High risk: API layer must be built from scratch.

acceptance: New Course form creates course via POST /api/admin/courses
Edit Course form pre-fills data and saves via PATCH /api/admin/courses/[id]
Delete button shows confirmation dialog, removes via DELETE /api/admin/courses/[id]
Registration status toggle (OPEN/CLOSED) works from list view inline
npm run typecheck && npm run lint pass
files: src/app/[locale]/admin/courses/page.tsx (refactor — add edit/delete/toggle actions per row)
src/dictionaries/types.ts (update — add course form keys to AdminDict)
dependencies: CM-001 provides POST/PATCH/DELETE API — verify completeness before starting.
verification: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && create a course, edit it, delete it, toggle status — all via admin UI.
